t3_apsp_matrix.notes: All-sources Bellman-Ford as ONE vector label propagation over pre-wired channels (lib/chan_gen): for arc u->v, u listens to v's row stream with meta w; rows are tuple-trees over targets, updated leafwise (min(D_u, D_v + w)); global no-change test hidden behind 3 speculative rounds (lagged decision stream fed back through an unscoped lambda). Work ~11M itrs (O(rounds * m * 2^L)).

t3_bridges.notes: Exact: channel LP with labels root*1024+dist gives a BFS forest; after the last round each vertex picks a parent (largest-id neighbour one hop closer, from slot metadata) and appends (parent, S_v) to its stream; S_v = XOR of incident-edge bits (exact bitsets as word trees) XOR children's S, gated only on the parent field (acyclic dataflow). Tree edge is a bridge iff S_v == {parent edge}.

t3_cc_largest.notes: Channel label propagation (min label) + chain of keyed increments on the label tree (scatter-count) + balanced max. Walk (~9.4 rounds/edge) dominates.

t3_count_shortest_paths.notes: BFS by channel LP (hop-distance labels) + gated dataflow path count appended to each vertex's stream after the last round (sums counts of strictly-closer neighbours; the switch waits only on distances).

t3_degrees.notes: Keyed increments on a vertex tuple-tree + tail-threaded flatten. At the Bend list-walk floor (~9 rounds/cell); remaining gap to native is the walk (native ~2.3 rounds/cell), which Bend cannot express.

t3_euler_start.notes: One walk builds channel slots + degree tree; channel LP components; one balanced reduction (roots among non-isolated, odd count, min ids).

t3_forest_mis.notes: Rootless tree DP as an acyclic dataflow of edge messages (unscoped-lambda wires, two per edge): m(u->v) = (1 + sum out, sum max(in,out)) over u's other neighbours via an exclusive-sum up/down pass on u's Braun tree of slots; answer = sum over vertices of MIS(component) - sum over edges of MIS(component). No rounds, no rooting.

t3_line_graph_edges.notes: exp7 strong-author Bend reused unchanged (keyed increments + balanced sum of d(d-1)/2); at the Bend list-walk floor; no variant improved it (walk unrolling/fold give the same ~9 rounds/cell).

t3_sp_count.notes: Directed version of count_shortest_paths: one channel per arc, BFS by channel LP, gated dataflow path counts.

t3_walk_count.notes: Meet in the middle: forward (from s, ceil(k/2) rounds) and backward (from t, floor(k/2) rounds) walk-count propagation over two channel networks wired by one walk, fixed rounds with no global test (whole k-round structure unfolds up front), then a balanced dot product. Halving the rounds cut depth 1683 -> 1355.

t3_wiener_index.notes: All-sources BFS as one bitset label propagation over channels: R_{r+1}(v) = R_r(v) | OR of neighbours' R_r; dist(u,v) = #{r : u not in R_r(v)}, so each vertex accumulates n - |R_r(v)| (SWAR popcount) per round; answer/2. Work 4.8M itrs (bitsets of n bits per vertex per round).

t3_wsp_all_from.notes: exp7 strong-author Bend kept (frontier Bellman-Ford over tuple-trees, Braun adjacency). A channel-stream Bellman-Ford variant (src/alt_t3_wsp_all_from_chan.src) had depth 1018/2278 (seed0/seed1 medians) vs 891/2872 and 2.6x the interactions, so it was not adopted.

t5_cluster_closure_pairs.notes: Channel LP components + scatter-count sizes + balanced sum of s(s-1)/2.

t5_cluster_count.notes: Components by label propagation over pre-wired channels (lib/chan): per edge two unscoped-lambda wires; every vertex is a persistent process streaming its label, one round = balanced min over its Braun tree of input streams (~50 depth); change flags OR-zipped up the vertex tree and fed back as a decision stream lagged by K=3 rounds (hides the global test). Count vertices keeping their own id.

t5_cluster_emit.notes: Channel LP with labels 4095-id (min = largest member) + filtered tail-threaded flatten of (d, canon).

t5_cluster_largest.notes: Channel LP components + scatter-count sizes (chain of keyed increments; an O(n^2) counting variant had the same depth and 2.5x the work) + balanced max.

t5_cluster_list.notes: Channel LP (min label) + keyed push-front into label buckets threaded from the largest vertex down (ascending members) + flatten of non-empty buckets.

t5_conflict_flags.notes: Clustering list read into an index-keyed tuple-tree that GROWS during the walk (MSB-first keys; (tree, zeros) when i reaches 2^l, so no length needed up front); mnl list read in parallel, keyed reads c[a], c[b] and a keyed OR into a flag tree; output zips index tree and flag tree. Beats frozen on both depth and interactions.

t5_decide_filter.notes: Plain filter with the recursive call before the accept test. At the Bend list-walk floor (~9 rounds/cell); the frozen author's 2-unrolled filter is equivalent. No improvement possible beyond noise.

t5_decide_order.notes: Bucket sort on score (contract bounds score to 0..1000): keyed pushes into a 1024-leaf tree during the walk (accept test at the leaf), lazy insertion sort by (u, v) per bucket, flatten in key order. Higher constant work (1024-leaf tree) than the frozen merge sort.

t5_metric_purity.notes: Two label lists read in parallel into growing index trees, zipped; two all-pairs passes (class sizes c_i, then group representatives) with O(n^2) work and O(levels) depth, using only label equality. Depth 10294 -> 1562 but 7.7M interactions (58x the frozen merge sort; a Braun-tree variant gave 1844 depth / 4.5M). Bend has no cheap hashing into small buckets for arbitrary 24-bit labels.

t5_reconcile_canon.notes: Accepted iff some occurrence has score >= tau; the walk wires channels only for accepted occurrences (test at the leaf of the keyed update, off the walk chain: 23 -> 10 rounds/cell), channel LP with labels 4095-id, flatten.
